releases.title: Censorship-Resistant Code: How Open-Source Developers Are Building Beyond Big Tech Infrastructure
releases.summary:
Decentralizing open-source development: How developers are moving beyond corporate code hubs to protect software freedom.
An in-depth analysis of the vulnerabilities in modern software hosting and developer coordination. Learn how centralized platforms threaten open-source projects, how Git paired with Nostr and P2P networks creates uncensorable code repositories, and how Lightning-powered micro-bounties provide sustainable Value-for-Value funding for developers.

releases.title: The Privacy Shield: How to Protect Your Transactional Footprint on Bitcoin & Lightning
releases.summary:
Reclaim your financial privacy: Practical techniques for protecting your transaction history on Bitcoin and Lightning.
A detailed technical analysis of blockchain surveillance heuristics and operational privacy tools. Learn how chain analytics firms track addresses, how to break tracking heuristics using PayJoin and Silent Payments, and how to utilize the Lightning Network for anonymous, onion-routed micro-transactions.

releases.title: How to Quit Big Tech: A Creator's Playbook for Building an Audience on Nostr & Getting Paid in Sats
releases.summary:
Ditch algorithmic censorship and platform fees: The ultimate guide to building a sovereign creative business on Nostr and Lightning.
A practical, tactical playbook for independent creators, writers, and journalists looking to migrate from Big Tech platforms to open protocols. Learn how public key identity works, how to configure your Lightning address for direct zaps, and how to use the Value-for-Value model to monetize long-form articles in sats without gatekeepers.

releases.title: The Death of Paper Money: Why CBDCs Will Fail and Open Protocols Will Win
releases.summary:
Programmable surveillance vs. open-source freedom: Why Central Bank Digital Currencies are doomed to fail against open protocols.
An incisive economic and sociological analysis of the rise of CBDCs. Discover how central planners aim to use digital fiat to enforce spending limits, negative interest rates, and financial censorship, and why the superior economics of Bitcoin and the Lightning Network will make state surveillance money obsolete.

releases.title: 🗞️ The Sovereign Recap: Bitcoin, Nostr, Privacy & Financial Freedom
releases.summary: A complete breakdown of the top news from September 21–28, 2026. This edition covers the SEC & CFTC regulatory shifts following the stalled CLARITY Act, Hester Peirce’s final warning against KYC surveillance, European pushback against DAC8, and the ongoing expansion of self-custody tools and Lightning Zaps across Nostr.

releases.title: The Ultimate Self-Custody Guide: How to Secure Your Bitcoin and Keys Without Relying on Anyone
releases.summary:
Stop leaving your wealth and identity on corporate servers: A comprehensive guide to true cryptographic self-custody.
A practical, step-by-step masterclass on securing your Bitcoin and Nostr keys. Learn the difference between hot and cold storage, how to properly back up seed phrases on steel, how to protect your Nostr nsec using remote signers, and how to build a resilient setup that withstands human error and hardware failure.

releases.title: The Death of Centralized Media: How Open Protocols Are Killing the Gatekeepers
releases.summary:
Why the era of corporate media gatekeepers and ad-driven algorithms is coming to an end.
A compelling analysis of the collapse of traditional media business models and the rise of open-protocol journalism. Discover how open infrastructure, cryptographic identities, and Bitcoin Lightning "Value-for-Value" micro-payments are giving independent creators total distribution autonomy and direct financial freedom.

releases.title: How Circular Bitcoin Economies Are Building Real-World Autonomy
releases.summary:
Beyond Wall Street ETFs: How real people are using Bitcoin to build self-sustaining local economies.
An in-depth, human-centered analysis of Circular Bitcoin Economies. Learn how grassroots communities are moving past price speculation to build permissionless local trade networks, how the Lightning Network solves real-world merchant friction, and why earning, spending, and circulating satoshis locally is the ultimate path to true economic autonomy.

releases.title: The Cypherpunk Manifesto in 2026: From Eric Hughes to Nostr & Bitcoin
releases.summary:
From 1993 Cypherpunk theory to 2026 censorship-resistant reality.
A deep-dive analysis on the evolution of digital privacy, tracing the path from early PGP cryptography and Eric Hughes' vision to modern permissionless protocols:
Phase 1 (Money): How Bitcoin unlocked sovereign value transfer.
Phase 2 (Speech): How Nostr decentralized the global town square.
The Stack: Legacy centralized infrastructure vs. Open Cypherpunk protocols.

releases.title: Julian Assange Is Back: What 20 Years of Censorship Resistance Taught Us
releases.summary:
On September 17, 2026, Julian Assange broke a two-year silence with two words: "I'm back."
From launching WikiLeaks in 2006 and releasing the 2010 War Logs to enduring seven years inside the Ecuadorian Embassy and five years in Belmarsh Prison, Assange's story is the ultimate blueprint of censorship resistance.

This comprehensive analysis explores his journey, the legal battles under the Espionage Act, his 2024 plea deal, and why his legacy directly connects to the cypherpunk movement, Bitcoin, and Nostr.
topics: investigative journalism, free speech, cypherpunk culture, bitcoin & decentralized protocols
